description: The graph illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens and the Macro-F1 score (%) for two models: one with material information and one without. The x-axis, labeled "Number of tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 0.6 to 1.6, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)," is also a linear scale ranging from 48 to 58, with tick marks at intervals of 2. The pink line, representing the model with material information, shows a general upward trend from approximately 55% at 0.6 tokens to a peak of about 58% at 1.0 token, followed by a decline to around 51% at 1.6 tokens. The purple line, representing the model without material information, starts at approximately 52.5% at 0.6 tokens, rises to a peak of about 54% at 0.7 tokens, and then generally declines to a low of around 48% at 1.6 tokens. The shaded regions around each line represent the uncertainty or variance in the scores.
